session_selection.rationale: Production root plus one persisted descendant; later evaluator root excluded.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source clean builds in isolated network-disabled image with bundled dependencies; no registered CTests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Case/output/restart and documented resurface/jacfd paths exist; exact historical binary remains unbound.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate configuration, mesh, partition, physics, reconstruction, residual and solver modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal solver wrapper found; no external authorship investigation performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case inputs drive mesh and controls; no two-filename-only path found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor exchanges exist; 1500-step failed diagnostics show Re20 ~2.4% Cd range across ranks, not converged equivalence.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity and adaptive CFL guards exist; accepted plateau is not reevaluated after final averaging.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Jacobian artifacts and smoke diagnostics exist; no registered CTests and structural validation is not physics proof.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular source and report/manifests; historical binary and nonselected plot bindings qualified.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative NS and nondimensionalization described; physical result accuracy assessed separately.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS multizone TRI/QUAD/BAR reader and adjacency; MIXED sections explicitly unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face conservative residual and wall/farfield paths implemented; final averaging can invalidate plateau assumption.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Roe/Rusanov numerical flux choices exist; first-order farfield sponge disclosed.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths and boundary-state surface output present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ reconstruction and limiter active after disclosed startup; M200 laminar only748 steps after 12500 first-order steps.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkatakrishnan and positivity controls exist; transient limiter frozen at predictor and report discloses it.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier terms and explicit tangential force projection residual.cpp:202–215.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS and averaged-state plateau method exist, but final500 force means shift after acceptance without a new test.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2/GMRES and periodic St0.160 supported; reported target ratio uses predictor-frozen limiter, refreshed-limiter strict behavior unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only mesh preprocessing, METIS and neighbor halos; short rank diagnostics not converged and Re20 differs ~2.4%.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight structural packages pass, but Re20/M015 averaged outputs are marked converged after the accepted force mean shifts.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Recorded validator passes all packages/report; structural pass is not numerical proof.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re20/M015 final averaging phase shifts Cd means substantially after plateau acceptance; other shortfalls alone do not prove failed cases.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 St0.160 supported, M080/M200 inviscid tails bounded, while M015/Re20 mean shifts and M200 laminar drift limit confidence.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: All22 report pages render; three laminar force plots compress both late coefficients and Re200 late drag is unresolved.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses averaging/startup/frozen limiter but plateau claim does not persist into final averaging and rank comparison overstates agreement.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original tracked manifest identifies results; three separate rerenders differ in pixels in this environment, so exact image binding remains qualified.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable source clean-builds with bundled dependencies; CLI/restart and output contract exist, no registered CTests.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS zones, TRI/QUAD/BAR and face adjacency implemented; MIXED sections explicitly rejected.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative Roe/Rusanov, characteristic and wall paths exist; steady plateau drift and physical limitations constrain verification.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ, limiter and positivity implemented; long first-order startup and farfield sponge disclosed, no independent smooth-order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian/Fourier terms and tangential wall force projection implemented; laminar force histories are not display-readable.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS/GMRES and BDF residual with predictor-frozen limiter exist; fully refreshed-limiter target not verified and final plateau is not rechecked after averaging.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only global preprocessing, METIS and neighbor halos; 1500-step rank diagnostics have modest differences and are explicitly unfinished.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: All eight packages structurally pass; M015/Re20 final averaging shifts depart from accepted means, other steady tails and Re200 wake have qualified evidence.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: 22-page report and galleries document methods and limits, but three steady laminar plots compress both late forces and Re200 late drag is unresolved.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate mesh, physics, reconstruction, residual and solver modules; 2-D geometric interfaces limit extension.
